positions.subject: q:housing/citywide-rezoning
positions.summary: In GrowSF's questionnaire, called Mayor Lurie's Family Zoning plan a great first step in the right direction and said by-right approvals for code-compliant housing are also needed.

citations.quote: Mayor Lurie’s Family Zoning plan is a great first step. It moves San Francisco in the right direction, but zoning alone will not solve our housing crisis.
citations.locator: Housing: Do you think Mayor Lurie's Family zoning plan is too ambitious or not ambitious enough?

citations.quote: Importantly, that includes by-right approvals for code-compliant housing.
